breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix this inconsistency. It explicitly kept the incorrect instruction 'Take the free-end rotation to be zero', which contradicts the physics of a cantilever beam under a point load. The ground truth correctly removes this erroneous constraint.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix this inconsistency. It included the incorrect instruction 'Use the constant moment M = P * L over the full span for the deflection calculation'. The bending moment in a cantilever beam with an end load is not constant but varies linearly. The ground truth correctly removes this physically inaccurate instruction.
